evals.prompt: Create a traditional Lex-only bot for checking parking ticket status. Users provide ticket number and license plate last 4 digits. Use numeric IDs.
evals.expected_output: Bot deployed with CheckStatus (2 slots), SMSOptIn, EndConversation intents. No KB. Phone number working.

evals.prompt: Build a library book hold status checker. Patrons call with library card number and PIN to check if their holds are ready.
evals.expected_output: Lex bot with PatronsTable, HoldsTable, Lambda handler, Connect flow, phone number.

evals.prompt: Create a package delivery status bot for a shipping company. Customers provide tracking number and zip code to verify.
evals.expected_output: Traditional IVR with CheckStatus intent, DynamoDB tables, no AI components.
